comment: Param 15, Corrupt Bank, is configured with configButton (src/Corrupter.cpp:188) and given a BooleanTrigger (:153), but no widget is ever added for it and processBlock never reads it. It has no paramPos in the census, so no click can reach it and it gets no line; the bank is instead derived from the algorithm at :308-309, algorithms 0-2 being Legacy and 3-4 Expanded. The DSP library also carries a corrupt_gate_v input (vendor/corrupter-dsp/include/corrupter_dsp/engine.h:70) that the VCV wrapper never supplies, so there is no CORRUPT gate jack on the panel. The BEND and BREAK buttons gate their stages only in macro mode: the micro branch of ApplyTickEvents (engine.cpp:440-468) applies the BREAK knob's subsection choice with no test of break_enabled at all, and applies tape wow, flutter and drive with no test of bend_enabled, so an unlit button is not the whole of 'off' in micro mode. The Bend CV jack changes meaning with the mode — divided by 5V in macro, read as 1V per octave in micro (engine.cpp:833-835) — so its range field is left blank rather than given one spelling that is wrong half the time. Panel lettering is drawn at runtime with NanoVG (CorrupterLabels, src/Corrupter.cpp:635-704), so the SVG renders blank; the label strings there are the authority for the panel names used above, including GW, SLNC and ST MODE. The three CV attenuator trimpots and the six CV jacks carry no printed label. Nothing in the plugin reads getChannels or getPolyVoltage, so no port is polyphonic. Internal clock period is 0.0125 to 16 seconds, exponential (vendor/corrupter-dsp/src/internal/clock_engine.cpp:13-14, :160-164); the external multiplier table is at :155.
